_: The vertical lines each host's text sits on, by name, with the arithmetic that puts it there. alignment.spec.ts measures the LEFT EDGE OF THE TEXT (a Range over the element's contents, not the box) of every element the selectors find, at 1500px wide, and fails any that is more than `tolerance` from every named line. A line with an `open` note is a disagreement recorded, not approved: it is listed so the spec is green today and so the day it is fixed the entry is deleted, like parity-allow.json. Add a line only with its sum.

box.why: one gutter from the window: the apps are tools on the bleed grid since 2026-10-04 (grid.css .wm-grid--bleed: no margin, and a box on the window's edge pads one --grid-gutter, 24 at 1500px); section labels, the default dial's label and any control's box edge

inset.why: box 24 + 1px border + 12px field padding; the text inside every field, the upload button and the mode buttons (a transparent 1px edge)

box.why: one gutter from the window: the apps are tools on the bleed grid since 2026-10-04 (grid.css .wm-grid--bleed: no margin, and a box on the window's edge pads one --grid-gutter, 24 at 1500px); the title, its caption, every group label

inset.why: box 24 + 1px border + 12px field padding; the label inside every dial row

chip.why: box 24 + the zone chip's 12px padding, no border

tabs.why: the canvas's first column line at 1500px, no margin: the rail's 5 columns (5 x 39.5) + 5 gutters (5 x 24) = 317.5. Bare text aligns by its glyphs: Words (the bar is pulled left by the tab's own 8px padding, and a tab's words start at its padding edge, not centred in the bold width) and the mode label under it (shell.css, scenes.css)

submenu.why: the stage's 4th column line at 1500: tabs 317.5 + 3 columns and gutters (3 x 63.5). The mode label's box is at least 154px, rounded up to whole columns less the 8px every submenu item insets its text (shell.css .mode-row .mode-label)

baselines._: Pairs across the rail/canvas split that must share a baseline, in every canvas mode. Measured from the first line of text, not the box.

pairs.why: the header row: ReCal Builder and the scene tabs (shell.css .canvas-bar, +2px)
the second row: the rail caption and the mode label (shell.css .mode-row .mode-label, 8px - 3px)
the label and every item of the submenu the mode shows are one row (shell.css .mode-row, align-items: baseline)

steady.why: the row holds still between modes -- it dropped 4px on Paragraph only until 2026-09-25
